title: Trash Disposal Unit Launch Kit (TDULK)
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSEA.NAVSEA WARFARE CENTER.NUWC DIV NEWPORT
description_text: Amendment 02 The purpose of this amendment is to post questions and answers. All other terms and conditions remain unchanged. 1. I am currently having issues with drawing number 8992417 REV A. The drawing doesn't include the Width of the part. Answer: The width is 3/8 2. I have a question about one of the material requirements for the above solicitation. Would Nylon 6 be able to replace some of the parts calling for Nylon 6/6. The Nylon 6/6 is extruded whereas Nylon 6 is cast, making the larger diameter parts material easier to source. Answer: Nylon 6 is acceptable 3. For drawing number: 8992416. Would you guys accept an extrusion for the raw material manufacturing method? Essentially that would change the SAE AMS-A-22771. Answer: Extrusion manufacturing method is acceptable Amendment 01 The purpose of this amendment is to update the CMMC Level requirement from CMMC Level 2 (C3PAO) to CMMC Level 2 (Self). Please refer to updated attachment N6660426Q0321 Amendment 1. All other terms and conditions remain unchanged. Please see attachments for details on this opportunity.
